mintAuthority.summary: AA_FalconXUSDC is a direct IdleCDOTranche token whose shares are minted exclusively by IdleCDO 0x433d5b17... against USDC deposits. The IdleCDO mint logic is a transparent proxy controlled by an 86,400-second timelock; the tranche has no independent proxy or privileged mint key. Base USDC supply is inherited from Circle.

controls.label: AA_FalconXUSDC IdleCDOTranche token (deposit-only mint)
controls.capDescription: Tranche shares minted only by the IdleCDO contract (0x433d5b175148da32ffe1e1a37a939e1b7e79be4d) upon USDC deposit; no privileged mint role outside deposit.
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25526837, minter() returned IdleCDO 0x433d5b175148da32ffe1e1a37a939e1b7e79be4d. The tranche's EIP-1967 implementation, admin, and beacon slots were all zero, so the tracked token itself has no proxy upgrade path.

controls.label: IdleCDO (TransparentProxy) — controls tranche minting
controls.capDescription: The IdleCDO proxy mints/burns tranche tokens on deposit/redemption. Upgradeable via ProxyAdmin (0x9438904abc7d8944a6e2a89671fef51c629af351) controlled by 24h OZ Timelock (0xda86e15d0cda3a05db930b248d7a2f775e575a44). CDO owner = Idle Finance Safe 8/3 (0xfb3bd022d5dacf95ee28a6b07825d4ff9c5b3814).
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25526837, the IdleCDO implementation slot resolved to 0xdd596250f838af8862d30e9c78a143356894a18d and the proxy-admin slot to ProxyAdmin 0x9438904a.... IdleCDO owner() returned the Idle Finance 3/8 Safe 0xfb3bd022....

controls.label: Idle Finance 24-hour upgrade timelock

routeChecks.signingModel: The sole current proposer is Idle Finance Safe 0xfb3bd022..., threshold 3 of 8; the original deployer no longer holds PROPOSER_ROLE.
routeChecks.rateLimits: getMinDelay() returned 86,400 seconds. ProxyAdmin ownership points directly to this timelock, so implementation changes must traverse that queue.
routeChecks.pausersAdminsUpgraders: The Safe remains proposer, canceller, executor, and timelock admin; one Safe module is enabled, but execution of a scheduled upgrade remains subject to the timelock's minimum delay.

controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25526837, ProxyAdmin owner() returned this timelock and getMinDelay() returned 86,400 seconds. Current role reads showed the 3/8 Idle Finance Safe as proposer, canceller, and executor, while the original deployer's proposer role was revoked.

controls.label: Inherited USDC (Circle) issuer mint path
controls.evidence: Underlying USDC supply is issuer-minted by Circle; this wrapper holds USDC and inherits that base mint authority.

review.evidence: At Ethereum block 25526837, AA_FalconXUSDC minter() still returned IdleCDO 0x433d5b175.... The direct tranche had zero EIP-1967 implementation, admin, and beacon slots. IdleCDO's transparent proxy had implementation 0xdd596250..., ProxyAdmin 0x9438904a..., and ProxyAdmin owner timelock 0xda86e15d... with an 86,400-second minimum delay.
